items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: And I got a telegram from Paris to come to join Willy Lewis's band.

ctx.x: Not the same one. This is the Hank Jones -- was a little fellow, little, small fellow. He come from Louisville, Kentucky. Small fellow. Someone said "Hank Jones is here." I made that mistake when I come back, but I knew there was another Hank Jones.

So I went with that band and I stayed there. And I got a telegram from Paris to come to join Willy Lewis's band. And I was happy with Willy Bryant's band. Very happy. We used to go traveling, all down South and there. And Willy Bryant was up there, looking like he looked, you know. And we went down to a place, Oglethorpe, Georgia. And a little

girl come up there and said, Mr. Bryant, you sure look good in front of all them niggers up there." Willy Bryant--he's in full dress --pull out a great long switchblade, and the trombone says, "Oh, Willy, master race." Oh, we're master race.
